name: Scholar Reference Verifier
description: Free academic citation verifier. Detects publication errors, hallucinated references, and retractions using Crossref, arXiv, Europe PMC, and OpenAlex. Formats bibliographies in APA, MLA, Chicago, IEEE, BibTeX and Word.
